BUY FUSION WEAR FOR WOMEN

FUSION WEAR – SATISFY YOUR CRAVING FOR OFFBEAT FASHION

Centuries of colonial rule in India, coupled with the changing needs of Indian women, has steadily shaped the trends of Indo-Western wear. Today, the Bharatiya Nari is an ambitious career woman who also sets aside time for her family, thus spawning the need for clothing that is practical yet is inspired by timeless Indian traditional wear. Thus, enter fusion wear – an amalgamation of the best desi and western trends. 

Whether you are looking for kurtis, salwar kameez, dress material, etc., with a hint of both western and Indian charm, we have it all. So, come take a look for yourself at gorgeous fusion wear on India’s largest online fashion destination, Myntra.

FUSION WEAR - TIPS TO CONSIDER

The trick to choosing the best Indian fusion wear for yourself is to keep in mind your body type, individual style, occasion and also the time of day or weather. We round up a few handy tips to nail the Indo-Western look every single time:

Just like suits in western wear, the saree is such a versatile piece of clothing that just does not seem to be going out of vogue anytime soon. So, go in for a cape-style fusion saree in your favourite colour for an effortlessly glam avatar. Wear your hair in a slick high ponytail and deck it with a few hair accessories for added panache. You can wear this look on almost any occasion at any time of day, depending on how elaborate the saree design is. 
Fusion wear tunics are your best bet when it comes to fuss-free yet pretty everyday wear. Pick from those with a mandarin collar, butterfly sleeves, halter straps, asymmetric, cascading hem, and so much more. Different vibrant colours and the latest, trendy prints will leave you in a tizzy as to what to choose and what to save for buying next time. You can pair your favourite tunics with anything from jeggings to skirts for a look that is simple yet stylish.
Kurtas, Kurtis, patialas, anarkalis, leggings, harem pants, and other popular ethnic wear items have been lent a modern-day twist in our Indian fusion wear collection. You can wear these to college, work, weddings, poojas and festive celebrations – there is something for everyone and every occasion. 
Add-on items like dupattas, shawls, saree blouse, jackets, etc. will give you myriad opportunities to mix it up and wear your favourite pieces in different ways for various occasions. Pro tip: If you are opting for an over-the-top kurta or saree, keep the rest of your outfit muted.  

BUY FUSION WEAR ONLINE ON MYNTRA

In addition to eye-catching products from top brands, we also offer an easy 30-day return and exchange policy, free and fast shipping across all pin codes in India, cash or card on delivery option, deals and discounts, among other perks.
